### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Limit objective findings to those explicitly observed and stated by the doctor during the physical exam. Do not include patient-reported information in this section.
[A-Section]: Strictly adhere to the doctor's explicit diagnostic statements, assessments, and discussed etiologies. Do not introduce unstated clinical inferences, potential diagnoses, or specific causes (e.g., 'electrolyte imbalance', 'orthostatic hypotension', 'fluid retention').

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Do not attribute doctor's physical exam findings as patient-initiated subjective complaints or mentions, even if the patient confirms the finding.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately list all patient-reported symptoms and concerns. Do not make blanket negative statements about the absence of other complaints if the transcript contains additional patient-reported issues.
